trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task here — it is simply what you get for finishing everything else in this guide. Nothing in the game is online, so no multiplayer or DLC trophy stands between you and it. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the Strangers & Freaks strands and the last few miscellaneous trophies. The whole hunt runs roughly 200 hours at a relaxed pace.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game, and the one the whole roadmap is built around. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, and progress you made during the story already counts. Despite the name it is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and many collectibles are only partly required. The headline numbers are 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and any 70 of the 80 challenges. The only categories that demand everything are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunting quests. Nothing on the list is missable and everything can be done in free-roam after the story, so treat it as a long cleanup phase rather than a second playthrough. Do optional missions as they appear during the story — there are far more than 100, so you will bank most of them without trying.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps with a parachute. You can mix the categories freely, so pick the easiest ones first — flying under bridges is the quickest to rack up. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots, where every stunt is listed by name and stays marked once done. Note that 100% completion wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 and this trophy will land on the way there. The stunt challenges shown on map icons are not required — performing the stunt once is enough.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or drone race, and performing a stunt. Do each one at least once. Check what is left under Touchpad, Progress, Activities — scrolling over a type shows how many you have done — and filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) to find them. You will be introduced to most of them through the story and the rest appear as you unfog the map, so this usually pops on its own while you work on the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting-range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Find them on the map under Activities, Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to clear for gold, and some are locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows. The gold thresholds are not brutal — steady aim and a little patience beat rushing — and the ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy later.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 races in total. Find the spots on the map under Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones. Some locations charge an entry fee, so keep some cash on hand. You only need one win per location, not a win in every race, so if a course gives you trouble, bank the easy locations first and come back to the hard ones with a better drone and more practice.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replaying the same race never counts twice. There are 40 unique race locations around Leonida, tracked under Activities, Racing. Most locations let you hire a car if you do not want to risk your own, and your car's Rating matters, so spend a little on upgrades at a Mod Shop before tackling the faster circuits. Work through the list methodically and tick each win off as you go.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon west of Key Lento. Head there with a boat and a fishing rod — hijack one nearby if you do not own one — and fish in the marked area until you land a parrotfish over 2kg to beat him. The challenge is the whole trophy: one good catch, in the right spot, after Cal's message arrives.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck — at least once. The first three are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of a game, not beat every challenge inside it, so pick the one you enjoy most and play it through. The home TV is briefly unavailable during some story sections, but the games are still there after the story.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is exclusive to Lucia and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and then texts her home address in Belville. Complete all five of her quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. Every quest stays available after the story, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the Island Dreams mission, where you work for him, he calls and appears under a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure: he marks purple chest icons on the map, you dig the treasure up from the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring it back to his shop. After the first set he calls you back, then marks more — seven shipwrecks in total. Track progress under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees, and Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapter 2 or 3 — as Jason he will text you, and calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up. His final mission is Maritime Disputes, and it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all five of his quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last one. Everything stays available after the story, so fold his jobs into your free-roam cleanup if you skipped them earlier.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight Strangers & Freaks mission strands — but only certain questlines count. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy, even though they are side quests. The strands confirmed to count are Kirk's skunk-ape hunt (Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle's farm jobs (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago's racing arc (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother), and Pilot Pete's delivery chain (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries at Southpoint Airfield and Avery Allen & Co., plus Deliver Packages). More strangers are still being discovered, and every strand stays available in free-roam after the story. Watch the count on the trophy tracker in the trophy list as you finish each strand.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage, marked by a green RK icon in the west of Vice City. Track what he wants under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List: some cars he marks for you in fixed spots, the rest you can steal off the street anywhere — scanning a car with the WAiNK app tells you if it is on the list, and entering one you need pops a delivery prompt. The cars turn up most often in the east of Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. Deliver them in good condition for a better price, and finish the list whenever you like — it all stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are gone, Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down for good — finish it and the trophy pops. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. Both Lucia and Jason can meditate at each spot, which counts as two meditations at the same location — track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY IN THE GAME: the first meditation can only be done in Chapter 1, at Jason's house. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That meditation adds +1 to the counter, but it is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so it is currently unclear whether it is required for the trophy or not — the guide authors are still confirming it, and the author who earned the trophy had done the Chapter 1 meditation. Do it anyway: it costs a minute and it is the only one you can never repeat. For the 100% checklist only 15 of the 18 meditations are needed. You cannot do the final meditation until you can play both characters together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that starts the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map: hunt the animal he requests and bring it to him as Jason. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, which you can pull from any weapon locker at an Ammu-Nation. One clean shot leaves the animal in pristine condition and pays more, though it is not required for the questline. Track the hunts under Map, Activities, Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks in total, and all 15 are needed for 100% completion, so this trophy should come naturally along the way. It is still undergoing confirmation which animal exactly unlocks this trophy, so keep clearing Bret's requests until it pops.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Track progress under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. Cards you have collected can be sold at pawn shops and still count toward your sets, so do not worry about holding onto them. If you are chasing 100% completion you will need 15 sets anyway, so this trophy lands on the way there — pick the three easiest sets first and leave the rest for the cleanup phase.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up, then R1 while looking at a scannable object. The spots are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus the No Flusher tags — well over 100 in total, so it does not matter which hundred you scan. Track progress under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations. The fastest route is to sweep the marked landmark and curiosity clusters as you travel for other trophies, scanning everything you pass instead of making a dedicated trip.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. View and track them under Progress, Challenges — the completed checkmark sits in the bottom right when you scroll over one. Most of them finish naturally while you work on the other trophies and the 100% requirements, and since 100% completion needs any 70 of 80, this trophy pops on the way there. Leave it for one of your last trophies: by then most of the list is already done without trying, and you can pick the ten easiest of what remains.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: The earliest you can do this is after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level by causing carnage, then escape the red heat zone. The easiest escape is a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic, and if a helicopter is on you, shoot it down first. The cleanest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: the police struggle to follow you on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you, and the trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone (not the flashing blue-red search area). It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level you must escape.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch characters and call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). Hit three robbery targets — the green icons on the map — in a row while the police are chasing you the whole time, keeping the red-blue flashing wanted level rather than letting it drop or spike into the red heat level. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. The unlock is delayed: it pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop, so keep moving and do not panic if it does not fire instantly. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — rob a couple of items in each, crack the safe in the back room with sticky bombs, and if the police reach the first store before you leave, hit a fourth shop to be safe.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Discover any 100 of the 557 vehicles at launch. The fastest way is the WAiNK app on your phone — hold Up to open it instantly, then look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough; you never need to drive the vehicle. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes, and every new model you have never seen goes into the database. You need 200 of the base-model vehicles scanned for 100% completion, so this trophy pops automatically on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar in the top left. You must kill or incapacitate five enemies in that one use, and the window only lasts a few seconds. Set it up first: buff your focus with food and drinks or a wash and shower at home, then take Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch the slowdown. Line up five enemies — the criminals at gang operations are ideal — and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556, wearing body armor so you can step out of cover. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has four levels, raised by shooting-range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets much easier late in the game — at Focus Level 4 it often pops on its own during a big fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it has to be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes parked on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight for it, and use the stairs next to the boarding bridge, where a door leads directly into the plane. You can also walk in through the airport terminal on foot. Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before the trophy pops — the unlock is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it fires.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and start shooting enemies until the trophy unlocks. Expect heavy resistance on the base, so go in with full armor and a plan for getting out again.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies, which appear with a green icon in unfogged areas. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking the door sets the alarm off; the Snap Gun is a permanent inventory item, no need to equip it). Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, and be sure to destroy the security footage and disable the alarm before you leave — the trophy pops shortly after you walk out. A reliable spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress — it teaches the whole routine: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, wait for the guard to carry the briefcase in and the vault to open, then slip in and rob it while your partner helps carry the cash (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that quest you can pay Yasmani for security-van tips — he sells them for $10,000 once you have done his two Payday Loans quests — and the vans are marked with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly earns a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle, cut through traffic, then switch vehicles to shake the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and 100% completion needs all of them, so this trophy pops on the way there. Scrolling over a bank's map icon shows which vaults you have already robbed.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies: robbing a large bank's vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Tail the truck to the bank, get into the vault while it is open, steal the cash and escape the red heat radius — or duck into a Pay 'n' Spray. Since 100% completion needs all 8 large bank jobs, you will earn it without thinking about it. If you want it earlier, armored trucks also drive around Vice City near banks: block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests, and Yasmani becomes a fence automatically from Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. Do it in long sweeps rather than hunting one fog patch at a time, and combine it with the stunts and vehicle scanning you are already doing — most of the map reveals itself naturally as you travel for other trophies.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total and 100% completion needs all of them, so this trophy pops automatically during the cleanup. Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed, at the bottom right.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar with the view in front of you. That is the whole trophy — one drink, one view, one pop. Do it whenever you are passing through Vice Beach; there is no unlock requirement and no time limit.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only take it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — hack into the car, drive forward and out through the glass. The unlock is slightly delayed and pops after you drive further away down the street. Only this blue Banshee counts, no other car — it is a deliberate nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow the safe. The location is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, collect the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the office down the north-east hallway. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not required. It is not missable: if you do not grab all three during the mission, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for whatever is left.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, select a character and scroll to Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when character switching unlocks. Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club, filtered on the map under Activities (the dumbbell icon), or work out at home after the story. Always train together: call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle) and while one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count. Turn on the notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On) — whenever you do something that moves your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right of the screen. The profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies, limb shots), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones), and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence that you should avoid, since the police will shoot you on sight far more often. This mostly happens passively: every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so it should pop while you work on the other trophies. If it is the last one standing, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: During the Prologue, Lucia robs a Payday Loans store. This trophy is for going back later and robbing the same store again as Lucia — then getting away on foot, not in a vehicle. The earliest you can do it is after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. Go to the Payday Loans in Vice City, Little Cuba, alone as Lucia without Jason. Aim your weapon at the teller, deal with the security that starts shooting, break through the door and steal the money from all three cash drawers, then run. The unlock is delayed: you must escape the police search area and run far enough away on foot before it pops. You are recreating the Prologue robbery — on foot is the whole point.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and come solo. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside, sometimes it is not — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO as a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks. If the car is absent, keep retrying — patience is the only requirement.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Head somewhere crowded — Vice City streets or Ocean Beach — and keep moving: each kick needs to connect while you ride past, so pick a dense stretch of pavement and chain the kicks without stopping. Ten in a minute sounds tight, but in a busy area it goes quickly.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all your robberies, so you never need to bring it in one trip, and it comes naturally while you do the robberies for 100% completion. Bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery once they unlock after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, so a couple of vaults plus the Payday Loans runs will clear the total.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. The shops that count include 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. If you are already buying weapons and upgrades for the other trophies, this pops on its own — otherwise a single shopping run for a good rifle, a full car mod and a few tattoos clears it in one go.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — the 4 story-related garages do not count. Together they cost $160,000. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when you steal the Crawler for Moses: you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through it. The fastest money at that point is robberies, especially the higher-value ones that open up in Chapters 3 and 4, so do not rush this one early — buy them as your bank balance grows and it will pop without a grind.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, where you take a vehicle to Moses. The app lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. To register 10 vehicles you first need enough garages — each garage adds one or more parking spots, so finish Little Boxes first. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, click Respray and Register. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so keep expenses down by using cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
